text:
A plane mirror is fitted to a wall.
Which statement about the image formed by the mirror is correct?
A
The image is real.
B
The image is left to right (laterally inverted).
C
The image is smaller than the object.
D
The image is upside down.

options.label: B
options.text: The image is left to right (laterally inverted).

options.label: C
options.text: The image is smaller than the object.
